notes: The ground clutter of the camera's ring (simcore/scenery/clutter.hpp, roadmap T6.1, docs/scenery/T5_T8_PLAN.md): tufts of grass, stubble, maize stumps, dry stalks and reeds scattered over the ground layers within ring_m of the camera, from the layer under each plant. Game values judged by eye (Pannonia is fictional: the look, not the statistics); presentation only, nothing in the simulation reads it. Thin plants are drawn as crossed alpha cards (art/clutter, tools/make_cards.py), so a plant here is a clump: its width is a clump's and its density a clump's. Each 4 m cell draws its plants from its own position (the same for every client, and the same when the ring moves back over it), per_m2 at the camera falling with distance as 1 / (1 + (d / falloff_m)^2). A kind's part is a mesh in scenery/map_meshes.hpp (ClutterMesh) that a registered model may replace; height_m and width_m are drawn per plant; brightness is the share a plant's brightness varies by either way. The standing crops (wheat, maize, sunflower) have no clutter here: they are the crop blocks of T6.2. The ploughed and sown fields have clods (solids, not cards: a clod is a lump), the texture's furrows carrying the rest (plot lab p01, roadmap L5).
